newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products overshadowed by crude's rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products overshadowed by crude's rally.

text.p: NWE oil products were boosted by crude's rally on Monday, traders said.
Spot gas oil prices were firmer but trade was thin as buyers were scared off by stronger futures.
Gasoline was pulled higher by futures. Eurograde barges traded as high as $202.50 fob ARA in afternoon trade.
Naphtha was stronger but traders said the widening contango on the swaps indicated the depressed state of the near-term market. May was talked at $180/$181 and June at $186.00/$186.50.
High sulphur barges traded up to $87 before sinking slightly.
Traders were uneasy over the durability of crude's rally. Cargo markets were quiet, with paper gains pushing notional prices higher.
